exportIntro: Save your chat history to an encrypted file. Keys and sessions are never included.
recoveryHint: Enter the 64-digit recovery key you saved.
recoveryWriteDown: Write this recovery key down. Without it or your passphrase the backup cannot be opened.
includeMediaHint: Off by default. Media makes the file much larger.
restoreIntro: Rebuild your chat history on this device from a backup file.
restoreDone: Restored {count, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}.
offerBody: This device has no chat history yet. If you have a backup file, you can restore it now.

error.invalid_secret: Enter a passphrase or a valid 64-digit recovery key.
error.truncated: The backup file is incomplete. Download it again.
error.corrupt: The backup file is damaged and was not restored.
error.unsupported: This is not a supported backup file.
error.no_store: Local storage is not available on this device.
